name: patient_is_adult_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently considered an adult according to clinical or study criteria.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently considered an adult according to clinical or study criteria.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not considered an adult according to clinical or study criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's adult status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of subclinical hypothyroidism.
